description: This file contains utility functions for processing and normalizing Zalouser target identifiers, parsing outbound targets, directory group IDs, and resolving outbound session routes within the Zalouser plugin context.

methods.name: stripZalouserTargetPrefix
methods.description: Removes the 'zalouser' or 'zlu' prefix from a raw target string.

methods.name: normalizeZalouserTarget
methods.description: Normalizes various Zalouser target string formats into a standard form, handling prefixes and shorthand notations.

methods.name: parseZalouserOutboundTarget
methods.description: Parses a raw target string into an object containing threadId and isGroup flag, throwing errors if invalid.

methods.name: parseZalouserDirectoryGroupId
methods.description: Extracts the group ID from a normalized Zalouser target, ensuring it is a group target.

methods.name: resolveZalouserOutboundSessionRoute
methods.description: Builds a session route object for outbound Zalouser communication based on normalized target.
